role: One 16x16x16 chunk section's renderer: it rebuilds the section's two display-list passes (opaque, translucent) by meshing every block through RenderBlocks into a Tessellator, tracks its frustum state and distance, and answers the pass queries RenderGlobal's sort and draw loops use.
scope_reason: Section meshing is the core of the compared frames; the C mesher reproduces it vertex for vertex.

members.name: vertexState
members.note: the translucent vertex-state capture is replaced by sorting the section's quads by distance (water_quad_compare, water_quad_distance)

members.name: worldObj
members.note: context reference; the mesher reads an rb_world

members.name: glRenderList
members.note: GL display list id; native emits raw vertices per section

members.name: tessellator
members.note: the shared Tessellator instance is struct rb_tess

members.name: chunksUpdated
members.note: update counter with no frame effect

members.name: posX
members.note: the live pipeline keys sections by (cx, s, cz) in raster.c struct live_section

members.name: posXMinus
members.note: GL translate bounds of the display-list era

members.name: posXClip
members.note: occlusion query AABB bookkeeping

members.name: isInFrustum
members.note: the live draw loop skips sections outside the six clip planes

members.name: skipRenderPass
members.note: the mesher emits quads per pass and the draw loop skips empty passes

members.name: posXPlus
members.note: GL translate bounds

members.name: needsUpdate
members.note: stale marking on the live section cache

members.name: rendererBoundingBox
members.note: the live cull recomputes the section box inline from (cx, s, cz)

members.name: chunkIndex
members.note: stable-sort tiebreak of the GL sort era; the live pipeline's index tiebreak is the array order

members.name: isVisible
members.note: occlusion-query state

members.name: isWaitingOnOcclusionQuery
members.note: occlusion queries run only in RenderGlobal.sortAndRender's advancedOpengl branch (RenderGlobal.java:773); the oracle pins advancedOpengl:false (Main.java optionsFor), so isVisible keeps its true and no query is made

members.name: glOcclusionQuery
members.note: see isWaitingOnOcclusionQuery: advancedOpengl is pinned off

members.name: tileEntityRenderers
members.note: the chunk's special-renderer tile entities: the live client draws the world's (chests, ender chests, signs, skulls, spawners, end portals) through raster_tileent.c; their renderers are opaque and depth-tested, so the HashSet order the list keeps leaves no trace

members.name: tileEntities
members.note: world tile entity renderers are not ported

members.name: bytesDrawn
members.note: statistic

members.name: WorldRenderer
members.note: GL list allocation; sections are entries of raster.c struct raster_live

members.name: setPosition
members.note: grid repositioning of the display-list era; the live pipeline keys sections by chunk coords

members.name: setupGLTranslation
members.note: the mesher works in section-local coordinates directly

members.name: updateRenderer
members.note: rb_mesh_section is documented as 'One chunk section and one pass, the way WorldRenderer.updateRenderer builds it': the pass test, the y/z/x block order and the double draw of the camera's block

members.name: preRenderBlocks
members.note: GL state around the list draw; the mesher's flags carry the same information (t->has_texture and friends)

members.name: postRenderBlocks
members.note: tile entity display list draw

members.name: updateRendererSort
members.note: the translucent quads are sorted by squared distance with a stable index tiebreak, matching the vertex-state sort's QuadComparator outcome

members.name: distanceToEntitySquared
members.note: water_quad_distance is the quad-centre form the sort uses; the section form lives in the live water keys in raster_live_frame

members.name: setDontDraw
members.note: empty sections are simply not queued for draw

members.name: stopRendering
members.note: GL list free

members.name: getGLCallListForPass
members.note: the draw loop takes the section's two passes directly

members.name: updateInFrustum
members.note: the six-plane box test runs at draw time in the live pipeline

members.name: callOcclusionQueryList
members.note: see isWaitingOnOcclusionQuery

members.name: skipAllRenderPasses
members.note: sections with no quads are skipped by count

notes: The mesher contract is render_blocks.h: the C mesher emits the same 8 ints per vertex in the same order as the oracle's MeshProbe, checked by csrc/tests/test_meshes.c against out/java/meshes/. The 1.000001 world-renderer scale is applied in the mesher/raster path as the Java does. lane/idxclient: occlusion queries n/a under the pinned advancedOpengl:false; the tile entity list is drawn live (draw_tileents, the terender and idxworld work: chest lids from the S24, the spawner from the S35).
